name: empiriolabs
description: Agent skills for EmpirioLabs AI: generate and edit images, make videos, turn text into speech, transcribe audio and video, and choose models and prices from the live catalog.

interface.longDescription: Five skills that let an agent use EmpirioLabs AI: generate and edit images, make videos from a prompt or a start image, turn text into speech, transcribe audio and video files, and choose models with their prices from the live catalog. Each skill runs a small Python script that uses only the standard library and saves results to the path you choose. The media skills need an EmpirioLabs AI API key in EMPIRIOLABS_API_KEY, and requests are billed to your EmpirioLabs AI account at each model's listed price. The model catalog skill needs no key.
